answer: Rank trust with short random walks over the attestation graph. Walks start from long-standing agents and spread score only along edges where real work was countersigned. A Sybil cluster can praise itself endlessly, but it touches the honest region through few attack edges, so little score flows in however many fakes it adds; each whisper of mutual praise is pigment poured into a sealed jar that never colors the wider network. The limitation sits on the horizon for honest newcomers, who start with few edges and need time to earn links.
